scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rwa/contracts build && pnpm --filter @rwa/shared build && pnpm --filter @rwa/worker build && pnpm --filter @rwa/web build
scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-interfaces.mjs && pnpm --filter @rwa/contracts build && node scripts/generate-shared.mjs && python3 scripts/export_context.py
scripts.generate:check: node scripts/generate-interfaces.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @rwa/contracts build && node scripts/generate-shared.mjs --check && python3 scripts/export_context.py --check
scripts.spec:check: OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY=0 openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive && uv run --with jsonschema==4.25.1 python scripts/check_specs.py
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm generate:check && pnpm spec:check && pnpm build
